thread:
mara (AE): Hey team — Acme trial wrap up. Can we confirm teardown this Friday 9am PT? Need keys revoked, dedicated pool deprovisioned, VPC handoff, and logs archived.

sam (Solutions Eng): Friday 9am works for me. Do we have a list of API key IDs and dedicated pool names?

leo (Infra Eng): I have the pool id: pool-dedicated-az1-acme. Will snapshot metrics and put the instance group into drain before teardown. Also need a retention window for logs — how long to keep?

mara (AE): Customer requested 90 days for audit logs, but legal said check for any holds. If none, we can archive to cold storage and then delete after 90 days.

oliver (Legal): No active legal hold on this account. Archive 90 days is fine. Please keep an immutable copy for 30 days before deletion to be safe.

nina (Security): Please rotate hosted API keys first and revoke any ephemeral keys created for the trial. Provide the key IDs here. Also confirm whether any customer data exists in traces or KVs — we need to scrub PII before archive.

sam (Solutions Eng): Key IDs we have: key-acme-hosted-01, key-acme-ephemeral-78. I'll run revocation for ephemeral and hand off hosted rotation to ops once we confirm schedule.

leo (Infra Eng): Plan I propose:
1) 08:45am PT — take pool-dedicated-az1-acme out of rotation (drain).
2) 08:50am PT — snapshot runtime metrics + KV cache dump to s3://acme-trial-archive/metrics/YYYYMMDD/
3) 09:00am PT — revoke ephemeral keys and rotate hosted key with new key issued to customer if they requested continuity.
4) 09:10am PT — delete pool and release GPUs.
5) 09:15am PT — tear down VPC peering and remove routes.
6) 09:20am PT — run data scrub job over traces and KVs, then move archive to Glacier.

mara (AE): Good checklist. @nina any objections?

nina (Security): Looks good. For scrub job, please include these steps: remove PII fields from traces, redact prompt/response content flagged by classifier, and then hash identifiers using salt-2026. I want a sample run on a small set before full scrub.

sam (Solutions Eng): I'll do a test scrub on a 1% sample and post results here by Thu EOD.

ops-bot: Action queued: "acme-trial-teardown-1865001234" scheduled for 2026-05-01T16:00:00Z. Assigned: leo, sam.

leo (Infra Eng): For key revocation, I'll run: 
```
# revoke ephemeral
redwoodctl keys revoke --id key-acme-ephemeral-78 --org acme-org
# rotate hosted (generate new key and notify customer)
redwoodctl keys rotate --old key-acme-hosted-01 --notify email:acme-admin@example.com
```

sam (Solutions Eng): For archives I'll run this: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://acme-trial-logs/ s3://acme-trial-archive/ --recursive --storage-class STANDARD_IA
aws s3api put-object-lock-configuration --bucket acme-trial-archive --object-lock-configuration 'Rule={DefaultRetention={Mode=GOVERNANCE,Days=30}}'
```

nina (Security): Add a hash map of scrubbed tokens to the secure vault, not in plain S3. Use `vault write secret/acme/scrubbed ...`.

mara (AE): Who will confirm deletion from our side after 90 days?

leo (Infra Eng): I'll create a follow-up ticket to auto-delete after 90 days and ping compliance. Ticket: INF-5421. I'll include timestamps and S3 paths.

oliver (Legal): Please CC legal on the ticket. Also save the audit exports to `s3://acme-legal-export/` before any deletions.

sam (Solutions Eng): Quick question about Dedicated pool billing — do we need a confirm from sales to stop committed billing or does infra handle immediate release?

mara (AE): I'll confirm with finance. Tentative: customer agreed to end trial so we should stop any trial-specific reserved capacity. I'll loop in @finance after this thread.

ops-bot: INF-5421 created by leo (Infra Eng). Status: open.

leo (Infra Eng): Also note: VPC teardown commands (example):
```
# detach peering
aws ec2 delete-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0abcd1234
# remove custom route
aws ec2 delete-route --route-table-id rtb-0a1b2c3d --destination-cidr-block 10.52.0.0/16
```

mara (AE): OK — schedule confirmed. Sam & Leo will do revokes and teardown Fri 9am PT. Sam to post scrub sample by Thu EOD. Nina to approve sample before full run. Oliver to confirm no legal hold (done). I'll update the customer and close out after ops confirms archive and ticket INF-5421. :white_check_mark:

sam (Solutions Eng): Got it. Will post sample.

nina (Security): Acknowledged.

ops-bot: Teardown run completed successfully. Logs archived to s3://acme-trial-archive/, keys revoked: [key-acme-ephemeral-78].

mara (AE): Thanks everyone — marking this thread resolved.

leo (Infra Eng): Follow-up: committed capacity release request submitted to finance. Closing infra side after confirmation.

mara (AE): Closing on my end too. Thanks! :thumbsup:"
